# ECN-2026-016 - Change notice - Machining shot blast cabinet #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01

Reason for change
- Implement standardized lubricant for improved seal and bearing life on machining shot blast cabinet EQ-P3-L3-SB01. Current practice allowed multiple equivalent part numbers, causing inventory variance and installation errors. Standardization reduces downtime and simplifies procurement and maintenance documentation. Refer to historical maintenance findings summarized in SB-1010 for failure mode context.

Affected items
- Lubricant for bearings and rotating assemblies on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 will be changed to part number CFW-LUB-709. This is the only lubricant part number authorized for this equipment after this ECN.
- Maintenance kits and spares lists for P3-L3 inventory must be updated to reflect CFW-LUB-709. Update affected pages in SOP-P3-L3-03 and SOP-P3-L3-04 to reflect the approved lubricant and handling requirements.

Implementation
- Effective immediately upon approval, all scheduled and corrective maintenance actions on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 shall use CFW-LUB-709. Existing stock of previously used lubricants may be consumed under a one-time allowance only if documented with the maintenance record and cross-referenced to this ECN.
- Update parts master, procurement orders, and storeroom bin labels to show CFW-LUB-709 as the authorized lubricant for EQ-P3-L3-SB01.
- Maintenance personnel shall follow lubrication procedures and safety precautions as written in SOP-P3-L3-03 and SOP-P3-L3-04. Training briefings will be recorded in the maintenance log for EQ-P3-L3-SB01.
- Verification: maintenance supervisor to inspect next three maintenance actions on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 to confirm use of CFW-LUB-709 and update the equipment history record.

Approvals
- Originator: Maintenance Engineering (signature)  
- Functional approval: Plant Maintenance Manager (signature)  
- Technical approval: Reliability Engineering (signature)  
- Document control: Quality Assurance (signature)

Related documents: SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-03, SOP-P3-L3-04
